_doc: Signature moves. Each project gets one (sometimes two). Each is a single recognisable device that makes the result unlike the default. tags help the mixer match moods and domains. effect is a hint the emitters read.

tinted-shadows.describe: Every shadow is made from a dark version of the brand hue, never gray or black. Depth feels warm and part of the palette.

hairline-rules.describe: 1px rules, not boxes, divide content. Cards lose their fill and their shadow.

oversized-numerals.describe: Prices, stats and times are set very large in the display face with tabular figures. The numbers are the hero.

color-block-sections.describe: Full-width sections alternate between brand tints. The page reads as a stack of bold, calm blocks.

one-loud-accent.describe: Everything is neutral except one accent, used once per screen for the single most important action.

paper-wash.describe: The ground is a very faint two-hue wash instead of a flat color. It adds air without adding noise.

asymmetric-corners.describe: Cards use one tight corner and three generous ones. It gives the layout a signature silhouette.

inverse-section.describe: One section on each page flips to the dark ground. It resets attention and marks the key moment.

sticker-labels.describe: Badges are slightly tilted, outlined and flat, like stickers on a notebook.

terminal-labels.describe: Small labels use a mono face with a `//` prefix and wide tracking.

photo-first.describe: Photography leads every card. Interface colors step back and borrow tones from the images.

edge-light.describe: Dark surfaces carry a faint 1px highlight on their top edge, as if lit from above.

quiet-grid.describe: A visible, calm column grid with generous gutters organises everything. Nothing floats free.

soft-focus-glow.describe: Primary actions carry a low, wide glow in the brand hue. It feels like a lamp left on.

big-type-hero.describe: Headlines are set extra large and tight, and carry the visual weight that images carry elsewhere.
